reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Plateaus on squat usually come down to one of three things: not enough weekly volume on the lift, reps that never get close to failure, or recovery lagging behind the work. Try adding a set or two per week, keep most sets to 2 or 3 reps in the tank, and make sure you're sleeping and eating enough to recover. If you tell me your gym setup, days per week and session length, I can build you a program around breaking through it."}
